oneFilter.intro: Before I say yes to anything, or pick what to work on, run it through this:
questions: Does it move D-One toward autonomous? (Client's + contractor's favourite subcontractor · interchangeable humans · Darren out one month at a time.) Or is it just chase-mode?
Is it the current bottleneck? (Growth Wheel.) Or a shiny distraction from the real constraint?
Do I have capacity? I am a basket — rest fills it, output empties it. Am I resting as much as I'm outputting? Am I inside my 20% buffer?
If it's a deal: Is it what we actually want, and do we hold the power seat? The one willing to walk away has the most power.
oneFilter.gp: GP is the number that matters. That's how we keep score.
oneFilter.oneThing: One thing at a time. The beauty is in the open space.

monthlyGoal.title: Efficient Resting
monthlyGoal.statement: By month-end: identify what's driving the compulsive task-chasing + end-of-day burnout, and put real structure in place to protect the energy left for family.
monthlyGoal.success: Success is not 'I stopped rushing.' It's: did I show up to look at this directly, get sharper at noticing the pattern as it happens, and put one real structural boundary in place.
